quests.question: This person waits patiently for hours, holding a fishing rod by the water.
quests.hint: This person waits patiently for hours, holding a fishing rod by the water.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a fisherman. Fishermen catch fish from the sea, rivers, or lakes.
quests.funFact: A fisherman must be very patient while waiting for a fish to bite!
quests.wordExample: The fisherman cast his line into the calm lake.

quests.question: This person keeps the shelves organized and the reading room calm and quiet.
quests.hint: This person keeps the shelves organized and the reading room calm and quiet.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a librarian. Librarians help people find and borrow books at the library.
quests.funFact: A librarian can help you find one book among thousands on the shelves!
quests.wordExample: The librarian helped me find a book about dinosaurs.

quests.question: This person carefully melts and shapes warm chocolate into tiny decorated treats.
quests.hint: This person carefully melts and shapes warm chocolate into tiny decorated treats.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a chocolatier. Chocolatiers make delicious chocolate treats by hand.
quests.funFact: A chocolatier can shape melted chocolate into hundreds of tiny treats!
quests.wordExample: The chocolatier decorated each chocolate with a tiny design.

quests.question: This person stands behind a chair with scissors, with a mirror right in front of you.
quests.hint: This person stands behind a chair with scissors, with a mirror right in front of you.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a hairdresser. Hairdressers wash, cut, and style people's hair.
quests.funFact: A hairdresser learns dozens of different haircuts and styles.
quests.wordExample: The hairdresser gave me a new haircut before school started.

quests.question: This person talks softly and moves gently to keep nervous pets calm.
quests.hint: This person talks softly and moves gently to keep nervous pets calm.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a vet. Vets take care of sick or hurt animals.
quests.funFact: A vet might care for a tiny hamster and a huge horse on the same day!
quests.wordExample: The vet gently checked the bird's wing.

quests.question: This person wears a leotard and practices on bars, beams, and mats.
quests.hint: This person wears a leotard and practices on bars, beams, and mats.
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a gymnast. Gymnasts perform flips, jumps, and balances that take years of practice.
quests.funFact: Gymnasts practice the same flip hundreds of times to make it perfect.
quests.wordExample: The gymnast did a perfect cartwheel across the mat.

quests.question: This person counts out loud and cheers someone on during every exercise.
quests.hint: This person counts out loud and cheers someone on during every exercise.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a personal trainer. Personal trainers help one person exercise safely and reach their fitness goals.
quests.funFact: A personal trainer plans a different workout just for each person!
quests.wordExample: The personal trainer counted while I lifted the weights.

quests.question: This person wears a fireproof suit and helmet while zooming around the track.
quests.hint: This person wears a fireproof suit and helmet while zooming around the track.
quests.explanation: That's right! This is a race car driver. Race car drivers race fast cars around a track.
quests.funFact: Race car drivers train for years to react quickly at high speed.
quests.wordExample: The race car driver zoomed around the track.

quests.question: This person wears a hard hat and bright vest at a busy building site.
quests.hint: This person wears a hard hat and bright vest at a busy building site.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a construction worker. Construction workers build houses, roads, and tall buildings.
quests.funFact: It can take hundreds of construction workers to build one tall building!
quests.wordExample: The construction workers built a new school near our house.

quests.question: This person leads a class through slow, gentle poses on a mat.
quests.hint: This person leads a class through slow, gentle poses on a mat.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a yoga instructor. Yoga instructors teach calm stretches and breathing exercises.
quests.funFact: A yoga instructor teaches poses named after animals, like the cat or cobra!
quests.wordExample: The yoga instructor helped me hold the pose steady.

quests.question: This person often has grease on their hands from working underneath a car.
quests.hint: This person often has grease on their hands from working underneath a car.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a mechanic. Mechanics fix cars and other machines that stop working.
quests.funFact: A mechanic can often tell what's wrong with a car just by listening to it.
quests.wordExample: The mechanic checked the engine and found the problem.

quests.question: This person holds a microphone and performs in front of a cheering audience.
quests.hint: This person holds a microphone and performs in front of a cheering audience.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a singer. Singers use their voice to perform songs.
quests.funFact: Some singers can hold a single note for a very long time.
quests.wordExample: The singer thanked the crowd after the concert.

quests.question: This person measures fabric carefully, then stitches it by hand or machine.
quests.hint: This person measures fabric carefully, then stitches it by hand or machine.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a tailor. Tailors sew and fix clothes so they fit just right.
quests.funFact: A tailor measures your body carefully so clothes fit perfectly.
quests.wordExample: The tailor measured my shoulders for a new suit.

quests.question: This person works carefully at a workbench covered in small parts and paint.
quests.hint: This person works carefully at a workbench covered in small parts and paint.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a toy maker. Toy makers design and build fun toys for children.
quests.funFact: Some toy makers still build toys by hand instead of by machine.
quests.wordExample: The toy maker painted a bright smile on the new doll.

quests.question: This person often has paint on their hands while standing in front of an easel.
quests.hint: This person often has paint on their hands while standing in front of an easel.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is an artist. Artists paint and draw pictures full of color and imagination.
quests.funFact: Some artists paint huge pictures that cover a whole wall.
quests.wordExample: The artist showed us her new painting at the gallery.

quests.question: This person looks through a camera lens and asks everyone to smile.
quests.hint: This person looks through a camera lens and asks everyone to smile.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a photographer. Photographers use a camera to capture special moments.
quests.funFact: A photographer might take hundreds of pictures to find the perfect one!
quests.wordExample: The photographer took our picture in front of the fountain.

quests.question: This person sketches characters and tests levels again and again on a computer.
quests.hint: This person sketches characters and tests levels again and again on a computer.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a video game designer. Video game designers create the characters, levels, and rules of a video game.
quests.funFact: A video game designer might imagine an entire world before building it!
quests.wordExample: The video game designer created a new level for the game.

quests.question: This person steams milk and pours pretty patterns into warm drinks behind the counter.
quests.hint: This person steams milk and pours pretty patterns into warm drinks behind the counter.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a barista. Baristas make and serve coffee and other drinks at a cafe.
quests.funFact: A skilled barista can pour a pretty leaf pattern into warm milk!
quests.wordExample: The barista made a warm drink for my mom.

quests.wordExample: The hairdresser washed and styled her hair carefully.

quests.wordExample: The yoga instructor showed us a calm breathing exercise.

quests.wordExample: The gymnast balanced carefully on the beam.

quests.hint: Look at this picture: 🏎️. Which job does it show?

quests.funFact: A race car driver can travel faster than almost any other kind of car!
quests.wordExample: The race car driver crossed the finish line first.

quests.question: This person talks to a camera, then edits the footage before sharing it online.
quests.hint: This person talks to a camera, then edits the footage before sharing it online.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a vlogger. Vloggers record videos to share stories and ideas online.
quests.funFact: A vlogger might film and edit a video for hours before sharing it!
quests.wordExample: The vlogger edited the video before sharing it online.

quests.funFact: Tailors can shorten a pair of trousers in just a few minutes.
quests.wordExample: The tailor shortened the sleeves on my new jacket.

quests.question: This person wears a captain's hat and gives orders to the crew from the ship's wheel.
quests.hint: This person wears a captain's hat and gives orders to the crew from the ship's wheel.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a ship captain. Ship captains lead the crew and steer a ship across the sea.
quests.funFact: A ship captain is responsible for everyone and everything on board!
quests.wordExample: The ship captain checked the map before the long voyage.
